intro.title: Build websocket server with rooms
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a WebSocket server that supports chat rooms, allowing multiple users to join separate groups and exchange messages in real-time. You will learn how to handle WebSocket connections, manage room-based message broadcasting, and track users across different rooms. The core programming concepts involve using event-driven programming with WebSocket events and managing shared state for rooms and clients. You'll work with the Node.js 'ws' library to create the server and use basic JavaScript objects to store room and client data. By the end, you'll have a functional server that can route messages only to users in the same room, demonstrating real-time, room-based communication.
intro.usecase: WebSocket servers with rooms are essential for building real-time collaborative applications where users need to be grouped by shared context. This pattern powers chat applications like Slack or Discord where users join specific channels, live multiplayer games where players are grouped by match instances, and collaborative editing tools like Google Docs where participants work on the same document. As a Node.js developer, you'll implement this to manage user subscriptions efficiently, broadcast messages to targeted groups, and maintain isolated communication channels within a single WebSocket connection.
